title: pcapng-sysdig: use ckd_sub() to subtract and do sanity checks.
description:
Set the block_remaining variable at the beginning of processing the
block, and, for each part of the block that we read:

1. Do a checked subtract of the size of the part being read from
   block_reaining, and, if it fails, report that the file is bad.

2. Do the read.

Move the setup of wblock to the end, after we've read everything and
know that the block is OK and we have all the information we need.

This might be a pattern to apply to other pcapng-block-reading code, to make 1) let the compiler figure out the best way to do the check and the subtraction on a particular target and 2) make sure the checks are in place.
